messages:
maria: Heads-up — SableBank sent back the SIG (question-by-question). They want: POC access for compliance team, a short pricing delta between hosted vs reserved, and KMS rotation evidence. Can SE/security coordinate? deadline EOD Thursday.

dan: I can map answers. Can someone drop the PDF and their redlines? I’ll start with the key-management and network controls (Q3.x, Q4.x).

maria: Uploaded the PDF they returned: https://files.redwood.example/sablebank/SIG-returned-2026-03-18.pdf. They annotated Q3.2, Q3.9, Q4.1 as must-have artifacts.

kate: Quick security notes: for key management we should not share KMS keys or private material. Provide: KMS rotation policy doc, KMS key metadata (ARNs + rotation schedule), HSM/KMS vendor statement, and a signed attestation that customer data is not stored in plaintext on our control plane. I can prepare the attestation. :white_check_mark:

jared: For POC — SEs can spin a 7-day isolated tenant for compliance reviewers. Need billing approval for trial infra (estimate ~ $2k). If they want Reserved capacity pricing, we'll need expected QPS + seq lengths to quote properly.

dan: Noted on quota. SableBank asked specifically re: multi-tenant isolation during POC vs Dedicated. I'll propose: isolated tenant (no shared models), and a network ACL lock. Is that acceptable security-wise, @kate?

kate: Yes, isolation + Private VPC peering is fine. For Dedicated we can provide SLA doc and SOC2 attestation excerpt. Send me the exact SIG question IDs they flagged and I’ll map which artifact to attach.

maria: Flagged questions: Q3.2 (KMS rotation), Q3.9 (access reviews), Q4.1 (network segmentation), Q5.4 (incident response contact), Q7.2 (data residency). They added a note asking for a short pricing table in the same response bundle.

dan: Draft plan: 1) Attach SOC2 report excerpt, 2) KMS rotation policy + key metadata csv, 3) Proof of encryption-in-transit (TLS cert chain snippet), 4) POC tenant invite + steps. I’ll draft answers for Q3.2/Q3.9.

maria: SableBank also asked about credentialed scans and vendor pen tests — they want last pen test date and summary.

kate: Last vendor pentest: 2025-11-12. Summary: no critical findings, two Highs (remediated) — I'll include the executive summary pdf (redacted).

evidence-bot: uploaded file: KMS_rotation_policy_2026-03-18.pdf -> https://files.redwood.example/internal/KMS_rotation_policy_2026-03-18.pdf

d an: (typo) — dan: Got the upload. I’ll attach that under Q3.2. Also creating a small artifact manifest:

```
artifact_manifest.csv
- SOC2_excerpts.pdf -> Q5.4, Q7.2
- KMS_rotation_policy_2026-03-18.pdf -> Q3.2
- access_review_roster.csv -> Q3.9
- network_seg_diagram.pdf -> Q4.1
- poc_instructions.md -> "POC access"
```

jared: For pricing table — short template works best. Dan, can you drop estimated token throughput for their sample workload? I’ll convert to hosted vs dedicated monthly cost.

dan: They reported sample: 300 concurrent users, avg prompt 120 tokens, 10 requests/user/day => ~360k tokens/day. I’ll add headroom and produce an hourly QPS profile.

maria: Timeline: can we have draft bundle by tomorrow noon? I’ll do a final sweep and send to their security contact.

kate: I can sign the attestation by tomorrow morning. Also recommend we redact any internal IPs from the network diagram before sharing.

dan: Uploading first pass answers and manifest: https://files.redwood.example/drafts/sablebank/SIG-answers-draft-2026-03-19.docx — please review Q3.2 and Q3.9.

evidence-bot: link preview generated for https://files.redwood.example/drafts/sablebank/SIG-answers-draft-2026-03-19.docx

jared: I'll draft the price table and attach after Dan's QPS profile. Also looping in finance if needed.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging this thread as the canonical evidence bundle for SableBank. If anything changes ping me in thread. :pray:

dan: Quick question — do we send the pentest executive summary as-is or add a cover note? I prefer a cover note that calls out redactions and remediation dates.

kate: Cover note is better. I’ll prepare a one-paragraph summary with remediation timestamps.

maria: Perfect. Last item: they asked for a contact for incident response exercises — @kate are you our point?

kate: Yep, I’ll be the IR contact. I’ll provide direct email and a brief runbook excerpt.

maria: Closing check — target: bundle sent by 2026-03-19 12:00 UTC. If we miss, ask for a 48h extension.

jared: Acknowledged.

dan: Acknowledged, working on Q3.x now.

maria: Thanks team.
